samples: This module provides a generic last-in, first-out stack with operations to create an empty stack, push, pop, peek, check its size, and test whether it is empty. It also includes a bracket checker that returns whether parentheses and square brackets in text are balanced and properly nested. Its tests cover empty popping and last-pushed-is-top behavior.

This module provides a generic last-in, first-out stack with operations to create an empty stack, push, pop, peek, and check its size or emptiness. It also includes a bracket checker that reports whether round `()` and square `[]` brackets in text are balanced and properly nested, ignoring other characters. Use it if you need a simple immutable stack or validation for basic bracket matching.
